q: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as ____.
e: Redox reactions are characterized by the simultaneous occurrence of oxidation and reduction.

q: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called ____.
e: Chemists describe the oxidation and reduction components of a redox reaction separately as half-reactions.

q: Redox reactions require a track of each ____ to each atom in chemical reactions.
e: Balancing redox reactions requires keeping track of electron transfer to each atom involved.
